why: First dialogue occurrence of Char's Neo Zeon title (dialogue_10930, 'People who can't even grasp the Marshal's ideal!'). The character glossary already notes the rank as 'Marshal' but with the alternate reading 'Supreme Commander/Leader' left open; this batch locks in 'Marshal' for consistency and flags it for central confirmation. Recommend keeping it visually/lexically distinct from the unrelated title 'Colonel' (taisa), which the same mission uses for Char's older AEUG-era rank (dialogue_11004-11021, 11033) and which the source itself contrasts directly at row 11063 ('Colonel or Marshal, it doesn't matter').
